title: Valid Palindrome II
description: Determine if a string can be a palindrome after deleting at most one character.
pseudocode:
1. left = 0, right = s.length - 1
2. while left < right:
3.   if s[left] == s[right]: left++, right--
4.   else: return check(left+1, right) || check(left, right-1)
5. return true

steps.note: Initialize pointers at the start and end of the string.
Try skipping index 1 or index 2 to see if result is palindrome.
After removing 'b', result 'aca' is a palindrome. Return true.
